name: Cheech & Chong - Eighth - Drooler
description:
Indoor-grown, hand-trimmed, top-shelf. The Cheech & Chong Drooler eighth delivers 3.5 grams of premium indoor flower — dense, frosty, and cured for full flavor and a smooth, even burn.

Drooler lives up to the name with a mouth-watering profile: sweet candy fruit up front, layered with a rich, creamy sweetness and a smooth, gassy finish. Dense, resin-heavy buds with serious bag appeal and an aroma that fills the room the second the jar comes open.

Why you'll love it:

3.5G premium indoor flower — grown in a controlled environment for consistent quality
Hand-trimmed and properly cured — dense, frosty buds with a smooth, even burn
Signature Drooler flavor — sweet candy fruit with creamy sweetness and a gassy finish
Full terpene expression — rich aroma and flavor straight from the jar
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Premium flower, real flavor, and top-shelf quality in every eighth. Cheech & Chong Drooler is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
